definitions.explanation: An area not directly reached by light, providing shade or cover.

definitions.gloss: behind the scenes; in secret; behind someone's back
definitions.explanation: Out of sight, in a hidden or covert manner. Used to describe actions done secretly or support given from behind the scenes.

examples.english: To rest in the shade of a tree.

⟦{真夏|まなつ}→真夏：27793_manatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日差|ひざ}し→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧、{陰|かげ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{辛|つら}かった→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧。
examples.english: The midsummer sun was intense, and walking on a road with no shade was tough.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
{陰|かげ} and ⟦{影|かげ}→影：02191_kage⟧ are homophones written with different kanji:
- {陰|かげ}: shade, hidden side (the area blocked from light; the unseen side)
- ⟦{影|かげ}→影：02191_kage⟧: shadow, silhouette (the dark shape cast by an object in light)

In practice, {陰|かげ} is about concealment and the hidden side, while ⟦{影|かげ}→影：02191_kage⟧ is about the visible dark shape.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{陰|かげ} (shade of a tree)
- {陰|かげ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (behind the scenes; in secret)
- {陰|かげ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{支|ささ}える→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧ (to support from behind the scenes)
- ⟦{陰口|かげぐち}→陰口：06638_kageguchi⟧ (gossip; talking behind someone's back)
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{陰|かげ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (behind ~; in the shadow of ~)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {陰|かげ}⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{応援|おうえん}する→応援する：21988_ouensuru⟧ (to cheer someone on quietly/from the sidelines)
